description: This file defines event handlers for setting the 'updated_at' timestamp automatically before insert and update operations on the User model within the SQLAlchemy ORM framework. It registers these handlers with event listeners for the User model.

methods.name: _set_updated_at(mapper: Mapper, connection, target)
methods.description: Callback function that sets the 'updated_at' attribute to the current UTC timestamp before inserting or updating the User model.
